key_concepts: Water exists as a liquid before heating.
Heating water causes it to boil and change into water vapor.
Evaporation is the process by which liquid water changes into gas.
Water vapor rises from boiling water.
Water vapor condenses into liquid droplets on a cool surface.
Condensation is the process by which water vapor changes back into liquid.
The water cycle includes evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and collection.
The Sun's heat drives evaporation in the water cycle.
In a closed model, water evaporates, condenses, and forms droplets.
Sunlight exposure can affect evaporation and condensation in a water cycle model.
